info.name: DuyManh - Mentor Portal APIs
info.description: Postman requests for GET /api/mentor/projects and GET /api/mentor/invitations. Use with the labodc-backend monolith (default port 8080), a running database, and a MENTOR account that has a Mentor profile. Login stores the returned token in the selected environment. Invitation results depend on database fixtures; an empty list is a valid response.

request.description: Login against this same backend. The test stores data.token (or token) in the unified-compatible environment variable `token`. If your local seed credentials differ, replace the email/password in this request body.

exec: let body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('Login response contains a token', function () { pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Expected 200 with ApiResponse.data as an array. Projects come from the database used by labodc-backend and must be assigned to this mentor.

exec: pm.test('Response has success envelope and array data', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

if (Array.isArray(body.data)) pm.test('Project item fields are present', function () { body.data.forEach(x => { pm.expect(x).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(x).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(x).to.have.property('progressPercentage'); }); });
pm.test('Returns 401 without a token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Returns this mentor's PENDING invitations, newest receivedDate first. An empty data array is valid if there are no pending invitation fixtures.

exec: pm.test('Response has success envelope and array data', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

if (Array.isArray(body.data)) pm.test('Invitation item fields are present', function () { body.data.forEach(x => { ['id','projectName','groupName','studentCount','description','deadline','skills','receivedDate','priority'].forEach(k => pm.expect(x).to.have.property(k)); }); });
pm.test('Returns 401 without a token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
